Usage: droide exec [options] [prompt]

Run non-interactively (for scripts/automation)

Arguments:
  prompt                                The prompt to execute

Options:
  -h, --help                            display help for command
  -o, --output-format <format>          Output format (default: "text")
  --input-format <format>               Input format: stream-json for multi-turn
                                        sessions; stream-jsonrpc is controlled
                                        via JSON-RPC requests
  -f, --file <path>                     Read prompt from file
  --auto <level>                        Autonomy level: low|medium|high
  --skip-permissions-unsafe             Skip ALL permission checks - allows all
                                        permissions (unsafe)
  --disable-builtin-skills              Disable built-in skills shipped with the
                                        CLI (not supported in ACP modes)
  -s, --session-id <id>                 Existing session to continue (requires a
                                        prompt)
  --fork <id>                           Fork an existing session into a new
                                        session (requires a prompt)
  -m, --model <id>                      Model ID to use
  -r, --reasoning-effort <level>        Reasoning effort: one of low, medium,
                                        high (defaults per model)
  --spec-model <id>                     Model ID to use for spec mode (optional,
                                        defaults to main model)
  --spec-reasoning-effort <level>       Reasoning effort for spec mode (defaults
                                        per spec model)
  --use-spec                            Start in spec mode
  --only-tools <ids>                    Use only tool IDs or
                                        MCP:<server>[/<tool>] selectors (comma
                                        or space separated list) (default: [])
  --add-tools <ids>                     Add tool IDs or MCP:<server>[/<tool>]
                                        selectors to the selected set (comma or
                                        space separated list) (default: [])
  --remove-tools <ids>                  Remove tool IDs or MCP:<server>[/<tool>]
                                        selectors from the allowed set (comma or
                                        space separated list) (default: [])
  --cwd <path>                          Working directory path
  -w, --worktree [name]                 Run in a git worktree
  --worktree-dir <path>                 Deprecated: set the worktree directory
                                        in settings instead
  --log-group-id <id>                   Log group ID for filtering logs
  --list-tools                          List available tools for the selected
                                        model and exit
  --request-id <id>
  --depth <number>                      Recursion depth for subagent spawning
                                        (internal use)
  --init-session-id <id>                Create a new session with this specific
                                        ID (internal use, for subagent
                                        pre-generation)
  --calling-session-id <id>             Parent session ID for linking
                                        child/subagent sessions (internal use)
  --calling-tool-use-id <id>            Parent tool use ID that spawned this
                                        subagent session (internal use)
  --session-title <title>               Session title override (internal use)
  --tag <spec>                          Session tag (name or JSON object,
                                        repeatable) (default: [])
  --mission                             Run in mission mode (orchestrate a
                                        multi-agent mission)
  --worker-model <id>                   Model ID used by mission workers (only
                                        valid with --mission)
  --worker-reasoning-effort <level>     Reasoning effort for mission workers
                                        (only valid with --mission)
  --validator-model <id>                Model ID used by mission validation
                                        workers (only valid with --mission)
  --validator-reasoning-effort <level>  Reasoning effort for mission validation
                                        workers (only valid with --mission)
  --append-system-prompt <text>         Append custom text to the end of the
                                        system prompt
  --append-system-prompt-file <path>    Append file contents to the end of the
                                        system prompt
  --settings <path>                     Path to runtime settings file merged for
                                        this process only
